description: This file defines configuration functions for Nissan Primera engine types within an EFI firmware context, setting engine trigger types based on the engine configuration.

methods.name: setNissanPrimeraEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the engine trigger type to TT_NISSAN_SR20VE for a given engine configuration.

methods.name: setNissanPrimeraEngineConfiguration_360
methods.description: Sets the engine trigger type to TT_NISSAN_SR20VE_360 for a given engine configuration.
